shop_categories.description: detail shop categories (config/detail.default.json interiors) that set a terrace

highways.description: OSM highway values of the street nearest the terrace that allow one; a pedestrian area (a plaza) always does

street_search_m.description: How far from the terrace the nearest street is looked for

passage_m.description: Free width kept between the terrace and the building across

wall_gap_m.description: Gap between the shop's wall and the terrace

door_clear_m.description: Half the width kept free before the shop's door

piece_gap_m.description: Gap between a table and its chairs

set_gap_m.description: Gap between two units of a terrace

reach_m.description: How far across the street a building is looked for; past it the passage is free

along_m.description: How far from the door, along the wall, a unit may reach; past the shop's own footprint only along facades in line with it

sets_per_shop.description: Tables before one shop, alternating right and left of its door
